items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 11 at 2:25AM AKST until November 11 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Patchy blowing snow. Total snow accumulations
up to 5 inches near White Pass. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Klondike Highway past milepost 10.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult to impossible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow may begin as a mix, but will soon
transition over to accumulating snow as temperatures cool.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions where available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 10 at 9:50PM AKST until November 11 at 12:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds becoming Southerly 15 to 25 mph with gusts
up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka.

* WHEN...Until noon AKST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A series of fronts will move across the area
from Tuesday night through Wednesday. Winds slowly subside through
late Tuesday afternoon before another front moves over the area
Tuesday night.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
